scope.primary_heart: Anticanonical heart qgr R_e; only AS heart is a comparison subject.
scope.first_forgetting: Set-theoretic choices of AOU/OU markings above a fixed weak marking; finite W(E6) is the classification target. Global realization and exhaustion are not newly proved.
scope.second_forgetting: Isomorphism classes of admissible line objects inside a fixed anticanonical heart. Existence, uniqueness and admissibility precede autoequivalence orbit classification.
scope.groupoids_and_stacks: Deferred until after set-theoretic classification; no new stack claim.
scope.line_reconstruction: Direct application of the known Artin-Zhang reconstruction theorem under its hypotheses; not a new general reconstruction theorem.
scope.preserved_results: Intrinsic line criterion, RR+EP uniqueness, commutative/formal marking comparisons, Picard obstruction proofs and finite-algebra computations retained with their hypotheses.
scope.global_line_existence: Not proved in general; results about other specified hearts are not silently transferred.
scope.new_theorems: This revision principally changes scope, organization and definitions; no new global Weyl quotient or all-line existence theorem.
